document: BC Election Leadership Debate Delivers no Knockout Punches; Voter Intentions Still Point Towards Sizeable BC NDP Lead in Final Week of Campaign (Insights West, 2020-10-15)
note: Final Insights West poll before the 2020 election. Online, n=1,030 (decided voters unweighted n=779). Shares among decided voters from the linked data tabulations (https://www.insightswest.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/DataPR_IW_Omnibus_14Oct2020.pdf, retrieved via web.archive.org; the archived copy is truncated and was read by decompressing its content streams, row labels inferred from order and release text). BCU = BC Liberals; CON = BC Conservatives; AUTRES = 'Another party / an independent candidate' (Island cell is '-', omitted). n = unweighted decided bases. Tables also split Metro Vancouver into City of Vancouver (n=172: NDP 56, BCU 28, GRN 11, CON 3, AUTRES 2) and Rest of Metro Van (n=237: NDP 47, BCU 34, GRN 12, CON 6, AUTRES 1); only the Metro total is coded here. Region labels verbatim: TOTAL Metro Van, Vancouver Island, Rest of BC (coded INTERIOR-NORTH).
